title: SPRT: Fixed SPRT Parser Crash
description:
Fixed a crash that would occur when
trying to decode UDP packets (SPRT
packets) as SPRT packets while RTP
was disabled (unchecked in Enabled
Protocols). Closes #19559.

notes.body:
This is probably a good idea for the SPRT dissector, since that bit is always supposed to be 0. Might tweak it a bit.

It's still only a workaround for the underlying issue of a dissector bug. The SPRT dissector should not have a memory access error on any input, so I'd like to see sample data if possible.

Just to follow up, I dug a little deeper and did some debugging that you may find useful. It would seem the crash-causing bug is caused by p_conv_data still being NULL after attempts to create it if not found. I believe this is happening because somewhere in the flow of dissection of my pcap file, the dissector jumps back to the beginning and begins dissecting packets it already has all over again. This shouldn't be a problem as it looked like there is behavior to handle this however for whatever reason, the pinfo->fd->visited member of one of my packets remains 1 (Yes) during the re-dissection despite p_conv_data not being defined, which causes the creation function to return without creating anything and then later causes the access to invalid memory.

Unfortunately I still do not have a sample pcap file for you to debug yourself (although I am still working on getting one for you) but I will provide some of the print checks I added to packet-sprt.c as well as my terminal output after the crash and a WinDbg output screenshot. Hope it helps.[wireshark_debugging.out.txt](/uploads/39e26c6b6b9bc3ffd246449d498b9fdb/wireshark_debugging.out.txt)
[packet-sprt.c](/uploads/439b92fe596448b3c8eb1f9803f887ea/packet-sprt.c)

I have a sample file I am allowed to share that causes the crash. To reproduce, in RTP preferences (CTRL-Shift-P -> Protocols -> RTP), set "Treat RTP version 0 packets as" to SPRT Packets. This should then crash your wireshark with the following error:

 ** (wireshark:19420) 15:43:48.414190 [Epan WARNING] -- Dissector bug, protocol SPRT, in packet 10168: STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION: dissector accessed an invalid memory address

Also note that this crash occurs in the latest pull of master (Development version 4.3.0)

[test_crash_2.pcap](/uploads/45ff9ded0c7f2b3af4d47942f6584af3/test_crash_2.pcap)
Thanks, I will take a look and see if we can fix the underlying issue as well.

Note that this sample file will crash even with this MR applied.

You probably do want to send packets with version 2 to the RTP dissector, but it's not sufficient for fixing the crash.
